Title: Slave rule and As the crow question

Messages.Author: wargrim
Messages.Body:
I have a question regarding Slave rule and As the Crow.
Scenario :
Keith Moody is bleeding - it gets blocked by Carna.
I declare Tupdog uses it's slave rule and entrs combat with Carna istead of Keith.
Carna goes to topror (after combat).
Can I play As the Crow to untap my Tupdog ?

"Iusiurandum patri datum usque ad hanc diem ita servavi"

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: I don't think so, because the Tup Dog was not performing an action (let alone a successful action).

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
You cannot, since the Tupdog has taken no action.

Name: As the Crow
[HttB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Flight
[FLIGHT] Only usable after a successful action. Untap this minion. A minion can play only one As the Crow each turn.
Artist: Avery Butterworth

V:EKN Website Coordinator

Messages.Author: wargrim
Messages.Body:
Thanks for your quick reply

"Iusiurandum patri datum usque ad hanc diem ita servavi"

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> wargrim wrote:
> I have a question regarding Slave rule and As the Crow.
> Scenario :
> Keith Moody is bleeding - it gets blocked by Carna.
> I declare Tupdog uses it's slave rule and entrs combat with Carna istead of Keith.
> Carna goes to topror (after combat).
> Can I play As the Crow to untap my Tupdog ?
>
Action was blocked, thus it is not successful. Can't play As the Crow at all.
(on a side note, I'm not sure sending Carna to torpor after combat would be easy)

Now, if Keith Moody had FOR, he could play Freak Drive after the Slave-combat.
Tupdog can't play action modifiers, since he's not the acting minion.

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body: How does Keith Moody with FOR play Freak Drive when he's untapped?

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body: By anouncing the card and paying the cost. Nothing on Freak Drive stops you from untapping an untapped vampire. Generally, if one needs the card flow that bad they tend to hunt and play the FD, but if there is danger of being blocked then one can flow the card without the hunt in this case.
